_comment: Known object bounding boxes for aruco_camera_localizer. Keys are object names as they will appear in TFMessage.child_frame_id on /objects_poses. Values are full-extent dimensions (meters) along the object's local X/Y/Z axes. control_gui's _bbox_callback consumes this as {name: {sx, sy, sz}} for TCP-offset grasp planning. Match this catalog to the sim side (sim_ground_truth/config/lego_world_objects.yaml) so sim and real datasets give the same per-object dimensions.
